PlanProof 2.25.0 — behind-the-scenes update, nothing new to learn

- Nothing changes in how you check a drawing set. The coded note check, equipment tags, scale + title block and spell check work exactly as they did in 2.24.3.
- PlanProof now looks for its updates in a new, private location, and still falls back to the old location if the new one can't be reached. Updates still install themselves when the app opens; you don't need to do anything. Being on this version is what lets future updates keep reaching you.
- Each time PlanProof starts, it adds one short line to the usage log it already keeps: when it started, which version it is, and whether the update check worked. Nothing about your drawings is recorded.
- PlanProof no longer waits on the office file share while it writes that usage log, so the window stays responsive when you open it away from the office network.

As always: flagged for review, not a certification.
